description:
Phobos and Deimos have orbited Mars side by side for billions of years, quietly watching the Red Planet. Now they’ve come down to Earth on a new mission: finding places that could help humans prepare for life on Mars. Lucky for them, they landed in Egypt, home to some of the most Mars-like deserts on Earth! 

We’re two computer engineering students at the German University in Cairo (GUC), using NASA data to find Earth analogs for future Moon bases and Mars sites, starting with our own backyard.
